title.en: Move to Top for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: One menu item that moves a workspace to the top of the DSH sidebar once, like a single long drag. No favorites, pins, stars, automatic reordering or startup re-sort.
description.zh: 工作区菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，点一次只调一次顺序，等价一次长距离拖动；没有收藏、固定置顶、星标、自动重排或启动重排。

description.en: Adds one action to the workspace menu: move a workspace to the top once, through the host workspace registry. No stars, pinned categories, saved favorites, or automatic reordering. 7 KB, no runtime dependencies, no saved state.
description.zh: 工作区菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，经宿主 workspace 注册表只调整一次顺序。没有星标、收藏、固定置顶或自动重排；7 KB，零运行时依赖，不存状态。
